cookies.message: We use cookies to ensure you get the best experience on our website. By continuing to use our site, you agree to our use of cookies.
cookies.preferencesDesc: Manage your cookie settings. You can enable or disable different types of cookies below.
cookies.essentialDesc: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off.
cookies.analyticsDesc: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site.
cookies.marketingDesc: These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners.

policyContent.whatText: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide information to the owners of the site.
policyContent.howText: We use cookies to understand how you interact with our website, to keep you signed in, and to save your preferences.
policyContent.typesEssential: Essential Cookies: Necessary for the website to function properly. You cannot opt-out of these.
policyContent.typesAnalytics: Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with the website by collecting and reporting information anonymously.
policyContent.typesMarketing: Marketing Cookies: Used to track visitors across websites to display relevant ads.
policyContent.managingText: You can change your cookie preferences at any time by clicking on the "Preferences" button in our cookie banner or settings.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to FinanceDash! This guide is designed to help you explore all the features of your new financial management tool. Our goal is to simplify your money management, allowing you to make smarter decisions and reach your goals.

dashboard.title: Main Dashboard
dashboard.description: The Dashboard is your command center. Here you get an immediate view of your financial health.

points.1: Summary Cards: See your current balance, income, and expenses for the month.
points.2: Overview Chart: Track your balance evolution over time.
points.3: Expenses by Category: Understand where your money is going.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: The heart of the system. Record every movement to keep accurate control.

points.1: Add: Click the '+' or 'Add Transaction' button to log expenses or income.
points.2: Import: Use the import function to bring data from your bank (OFX, Excel, CSV).
points.3: Recurring: Set up repeating transactions (subscriptions, salary) or installments.

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: Powerful tools to organize your financial future.
planning.budgets: Budgets: Set spending limits for each category and receive alerts.
planning.goals: Goals: Create savings targets (e.g., Trip, Car) and track your progress.
planning.debt: Debts: Use the 'Snowball' method to plan the payoff of loans and credit cards.

reports.title: Reports
reports.content: Reports offer detailed charts on your spending habits, allowing you to identify trends and areas for savings.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.content: Register your bank accounts, physical wallets, and credit cards. Keep balances updated for trustworthy control.
